lines.text: Herod hears people say Jesus is John the Baptist risen from the dead, whom Herod had beheaded.
Herod had John arrested and imprisoned because John said it was unlawful for him to have his brother Philip's wife Herodias.
Herodias wanted John killed, but Herod's guards protected John, knowing he was a righteous and holy man.

wrong_details.true: Herod feared John and protected him

lines.text: At a birthday banquet, Herod swore to give Herodias's daughter up to half his kingdom, and she asked her father what to request.
The girl asked for John's head on a platter, Herod grieved but complied, and John's disciples laid his body in a tomb.
